translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Tyee iñuba tsana keenamupai rukula

Bene, midinguinutsumi cha'li, ñañi keraa inu dekuwa, tsejtu entsa detiwa: Junga ji' Diosa' pupunanu yanu bain, ufeenda tsure' keewaanunu bain midinguide, tsenmin juntsanu junga teedi' Diosnu aawa kure' keewaamulanu bain mi'de.

Tsaaren Diosa' pupunanu ya avindala cha' neinshaya midinguityude, Diosnu keranguityu chachillanu kuwaañu' mitya. Yalaa Dioschin juu pebulunu, 42 chu'chaya' mitya balejtu kure' delanteekiñunguenu detsuve.
Tsenmala iyaa inchi tyee iñuba tsana keenamu pai rukulanu 1.260 malu inbera in mitya pakaanu eenu tsuyu, tsaaren llakindya' pannu paba jali panakiñuundene juuya eenu tsuyu.
Tyee iñuba tsana keenamu entsa pai rukula, matyu Bale Ruku tusha keenamu ruku' ajuusha pai ulibu chi chumulan tsa deju', lanpaa chujtintsumi pallu jumulan tsa deeve.
Mun yalanu firu' kenu dekiñuba, yala' fi'pakisha ñi faaware' tsaa millangue ju'kenu detsuve. Tsaju' mun yalanu firu' kenu ke' bain dejupe' peyainu detsuve.

Tsenmin entsala, engu Diosa' mitya ya' palaa mijakaren pungama, tsaa selu llukike' shuwa jan jutyungaandyashu juntsaa tsanguenuu dejuve; naa pinu asa tirenu tya' bain, tsanguenuu dejuve; tsenmin chachillanu tichi tichi taaju puiwaanu tya' bain, tsanguenuu dejuve, naa-uwanu tsa tsanguenu tya' bain.
Entsa tyee iñuba tsana keenamu pai rukula' kuinda kenu tinbu de-inmalan, jelekenuu juwan jurusha faamu firuu animaa jitu, yaiba vingue' pulla' juntsa pai rukulanu detu'nu tsuve.

Tsenmala yala' ujkun buluya aa pebulunu cha' den neneinu kejtala, matyu yala' Bale Ruku bain kuusanu tu'vi' peyanu pebulunu tsunanu dejuve, laapu' pañuya, Sodoma bain tinu firu' pebulunu, tsandityu'ba, Egipto bain tinu pebulunu.

Tsenmala naa vee vee yai tene ma bululu i' chumu chachilla bain, naa vee vee sera' jimu paandela bain, naa vee vee palaachi pamu chachilla bain, naa vee vee ma uñichi uuden juu chumu chachilla bain, mengaanuba dekityu', pemu tsumulanu pen malu medya keenchin ne tsananu detsuve.

Tsejtu tu' chumu chachilla juntsa pai rukula depeñu yuj desundyatu, yai tene fandangu deke', sundyanchin tiiñuba veta' veta' meke mekekenu detsuve, matyu juntsa pai ruku Diosa' mitya pamula yalanu tsamantsa taaju puiwaamularen umaa depeyave tyatu.
Tsenñuren pen malu medya insha, Dios juntsa pai rukulanu aama manguwa' mangujtenu tsuve, tsenñu tsaindetsu mun keenamulaya mika wapannu detsuve.
Tsenñu iya kipiiñu-intsu selusha main entsandiñu meejawa: Engu ladei, tiñu demeewa. Tsenñu yala' kundaala dekeenaren, ma ñivish bulunu kai'sha deluwa.

Tsenmalan yala' lunu uranu, kala tsamantsangue daran kiwa, tsenñu pebulu paitya pela vele' keekiñunguiñuya, manbaateya tsaa millaiwa, tsenmin 7.000 chachilla depeyawa, tsenñu mantsa laramulaya jelanchin kai'sha chumu Diosnu uwain yaa tsanguentsuve tya', aawa kure' dekeewaawa.
Entsaba pai taaju i' puiwara yumaa puive, tsaaren chaiba main kenuu juve; wajtunun janu tsuve juntsa bain.
Entsaba mandishpaijuipunu tyujtyu pakara
Entsaba mandishpai anjee ya' juipunu tyujtyu pakaanmalan, kai'sha jelekenu velan jurundi' daran papatitu entsa entsa detiwa:

content.text: yachi Mi'ke' Kayamu bain rei dejuñu,
entsa tunu naake uudenguen dechuñuba yaichi mandiyave,
tsenmin Diosya naa-uwanu' mityaba rei juu tsananu tsuve, tiidetiwa.

content: Tsenmala Diosa' chachilla' 24 bale rukulaya, Diosa' ajuusha reila' chuchudinu chunjuutala chumula, tsaa teledi' waike' Diosnu aawa dekure' keewaatu
entsandila:

content.text: Matyu ñu umaa tyee tsamantsaa kenu ju'ba
yumaa ñu ajaatya' taaju i' puiwaanu malu jave,
naa pemulanu bain kavitu kenu tinbu.
Tsenmin ñuchi taawasha kemu, ñu' mitya pamu rukulanu bain,
tsandityu'ba, ñunu ura' keengue' meenguemulanu bain,
yala' tsangues nen mitya ñu tyee kunuu juñuba,
Tsenmin entsa tusha firu' kemu chachillanu bain,
ñu dekikenuu juñu malu bain yumaa jave, detiwa.

content: Tsenmalan juntsa uranu, Diosa' pupunanu yasha, kai'sha chumu jurudiwa, tsenñu Dios chachillaba veta' veta' tsanguedaa ti' pañu keewara babuu juntsa elesha juusha tsuna kataviwa. Tsenmalan pidya pidyake', warati', kuidya jelekendi', naa kala bain ke', naa kaa isha puka bain tsamantsangue pajtekaawa.
